key_safety.text: Most common adverse reaction was nausea (2% NURTEC vs 0.4% placebo). Hypersensitivity, including dyspnea and severe rash, occurred in less than 1% of patients. No serious safety issues related to rimegepant were identified.

citations.quote: The most common adverse reaction in Study 1 was nausea (2% in patients who received NURTEC ODT compared to 0.4% of patients who received placebo).
